reason: The plugin is a DSH UI-focused extension that presents real-time DeepSeek pricing-window status and a visual schedule for users, with features centered on a header/floating status chip, countdowns, timezone-aware conversion, and a modal timeline, as documented in the README and corroborated by DSH patch/injection configuration in package metadata.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH Web GUI 的插件，会在界面中实时显示 DeepSeek 的高峰/平峰时间状态、倒计时与可视化时段表。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak timing status, live countdowns, and a visual schedule view for users.

capabilities: Displays peak/off-peak pricing-window status in the DSH web interface
Shows live countdowns to next pricing-window transitions
Converts schedule times across local timezone and Beijing time
Renders an interactive 24-hour schedule timeline and status chip
Injects UI elements into DSH session header and sidebar via plugin slots

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DeepSeek peak/off-peak indicator for DSH Web GUI with live status, countdown, timezone auto-detection, and a 24-hour visual timeline.
README includes a pricing reference table and schedule rules for DeepSeek V4, so incorrect calculation or stale pricing could affect user cost awareness decisions.
package.json declares DSH bundle patch and client injections for web runtime/locale/UI slots, confirming runtime UI integration and runtime dependency usage.
Repository includes cordis.patch.yml and runtime entry files (lib) needed for DSH plugin mounting, indicating direct interface extension behavior.
